name: Draft notice with missing party details
expected: Includes clean editable placeholders [Insert Landlord Address] without inventing a fake address.
prompt: Draft a legal notice to my landlord, but I don't know his full legal address.
raw_response:
Here is the draft for your legal notice, structured with a placeholder for your landlord's address since you do not have it yet.

To:
[Landlord's Full Name]
[Landlord's Full Address / Last Known Residential or Business Address]

Subject: Legal notice for unlawful withholding of security deposit amounting to [Amount in Rupees, e.g., ₹25,000] and demand for immediate refund.

Sir/Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, [Your Full Name], residing at [Your Current Address / Rented Premises Address], I do hereby serve you with this legal notice under the applicable provisions of law, as follows:

1. That my client was a lawful tenant in your residential premises situated at [Complete Rented Property Address], under a tenancy agreement dated [Date of Agreement], which successfully concluded / was terminated on [Date of Vacating].

2. That at the time of commencement of the tenancy, my client paid an interest-free security deposit of [Amount in Rupees, e.g., ₹25,000] vide [Cheque/UPI/Cash details] dated [Date], receipt of which is acknowledged.

3. That my client handed over vacant and peaceful possession of the said premises to you on [Date of Vacating] in good and proper condition, subject only to reasonable wear and tear, in full compliance with Section 108(m) of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882.

4. That despite the peaceful handover of the premises and repeated reminders, you have wrongfully withheld the entire security deposit of [Amount in Rupees, e.g., ₹25,000] without any valid contractual basis or justification, which is contrary to the principles governing security deposits under the Model Tenancy Act, 2021.

I, therefore, call upon you through this notice to refund the full security deposit amount of [Amount in Rupees, e.g., ₹25,000] to my client within 15 days from the receipt of this notice, failing which my client shall be constrained to initiate appropriate legal proceedings before the competent Rent Authority or consumer/civil forum for recovery, along with applicable interest and costs, at your sole risk and responsibility.

A copy of this notice is retained in my office for record and further necessary action.

Yours faithfully,

[Your Name / Your Advocate's Name]
[Your Contact Information]

citations.title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
citations.description: In the absence of a contract or local law to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for other than agricultural or manufacturing purposes is deemed to be month-to-month, terminable on 15 days' notice expiring with the end of a month of the tenancy.

citations.title: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee - Repairs and Reasonable Wear and Tear
citations.description: Lessee is bound to keep and restore the property in as good condition as it was at the time he was put in possession, subject only to reasonable wear and tear and irresistible force. Landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions for normal usage painting without explicit contractual basis.

citations.title: Cap on Security Deposit and Condition for Deductions
citations.description: Limits security deposit for residential premises to a maximum of two months' rent. Requires refund of security deposit to the tenant at the time of taking over vacant possession of the premises, after making valid deductions agreed under the tenancy agreement.
citations.jurisdiction: Model Central Act (Adopted by States such as AP, TN, UP)

citations.title: Suit by person dispossessed of immovable property without due process
citations.description: If any person is dispossessed without his consent of immovable property otherwise than in due course of law, he or any person claiming through him may, by suit, recover possession thereof notwithstanding any other title that may be set up.
